exercises.instruction: Find the names of ten European countries from the jumbled letters.
Rewrite the sentences below without using the word 'people' but keeping the meaning the same. Look at the two examples first.
items: Examples: Russian people go there for their holidays.
Russians go there for their holidays.
British people work some of the longest hours in Europe.
The British work some of the longest hours in Europe.
3 Dutch people nearly always speak English. ................................
5 Japanese people often take short holidays. ................................
6 We do all our business with French people. ................................
7 German people go there in the summer. ................................
8 People from Israel travel a lot. ................................
